responsibility: Provides the crate’s compatibility layer for small foundational container and utility types, re-exporting the hash maps/sets, index maps/sets, reference-counted pointer type, small-string-optimized collections, and stack-growth helper that `rustc_type_ir` uses internally. It abstracts over nightly rustc-specific `rustc_data_structures` implementations versus stable fallback std/indexmap equivalents so the rest of the type IR code can depend on a uniform set of basic data-structure names.
